# Companion materials {#sec-companion-materials}

Companion references should remain useful when a reader has only a printed
page, when an EPUB reader does not expose arbitrary packaged files, or when a
website can offer a direct download. Each entry below comes from one checked
registry and keeps the same stable identity across those presentations.

## Download manifest {#sec-companion-download}

{{< alk-companion asset-half-adder-project-pack >}}

The download entry identifies the matching versioned bundle. Build it locally
with `make package-companion-bundles`, then verify its license, manifest,
internal and outer checksums, deterministic bytes, and source parity with
`make check-companion-bundles`. Public hosting remains optional: when a release
is authorized, add the final durable HTTPS URL while retaining the stable
versioned fallback path. A changed byte requires a new checksum; a compatibility
or content change requires a deliberate semantic version update.
